requirements.reason: Repository-owned migration policy, expand/contract, compatibility windows, recovery posture, and later-owner boundaries must be explicit and enforceable before production migration sign-off.
Current and future Alembic operations must be classified so destructive, data-affecting, dynamic-SQL, and special transaction patterns fail closed when unreviewed.
Alembic graph, dependency, multiple-head, and drift verification must be trusted test evidence rather than CI intent or manual inspection.
Empty-database and controlled prior-schema upgrade paths must run against a dedicated migration test database without weakening ordinary backend test database safety.
Old/new application compatibility rules must reject unsafe one-step schema changes and require expand/contract sequencing before incompatible changes merge.
Provider-independent timeout, lock, interruption, resume, rollback, and forward-fix behavior must be covered without claiming final provider/runtime facts.
Controlled PostgreSQL migration rehearsal must produce repository-owned evidence for current-chain upgrade, prior-schema upgrade, rerun, interruption, cleanup, graph, drift, and policy behavior.
Accepted database contracts must remain intact while final infrastructure, provider/runtime rehearsal, durable jobs, deployed observability, and recovery evidence stay with their owning later passes.
